note: Draft register for Spec 051 (design D-10, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign plan approved by the owner as written the same date (D-10 = member 9; consumer of Asset B built inside Spec 047 per E-6). Conventions as in Specs 032–047: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-PHASE104-RECORD (Phase-104's evaluation is the claim's record of standing and the census of record), ASM-HOLDAT-LAYER (the Holdat corpus layer Phase-104 counted is the counting layer of record), ASM-GAZETTEER-SPINE (the Spec 027 Stage 0 gazetteer, as pinned, is the site universe Asset B classifies), ASM-ASSETB-CONTRACT (Spec 047 §4's contract — form, classes, groupings, testable rule, digest discipline — governs the consumed asset), ASM-ADMIN-AS-CITY (the administrative class operationalises the design's 'great-city sites' wording, per spec §4.2's stated boundary), ASM-SHARES-CONTROL (comparing shares rather than counts, with the size/class regression comparison, is the design's size control), ASM-ROLE-COEXISTENCE (the sign's recorded positional role and a site-function distribution are separately scored; neither verdict is a verdict on the other gloss), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (integrity, asset, census, and floor gates precede any outcome quantity), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited), ASM-ROIF-GATE (campaign R-7 holds this member's results internal until the owner's publication act).

claims.text: An outcome under Spec 051 states only how the arrow sign M391 distributes, by share of inscriptions, across the frozen site-function classes of Asset B at the testable spine sites of the Holdat layer of record.
claims.boundary: The scope is sign M391 in the Holdat layer of record, at Asset B's testable sites. alternatives: the pooled Spec 047 result could be read as already answering the arrow question (it cannot: its measures pool all inscriptions and Roif's named ledger classes, never this sign's share)
falsification_tests: the claim is falsified in scope if any Spec 051 output states a conclusion about a sign, population, layer, or question outside the M391 share distribution as bounded here

claims.text: The verdict is assigned mechanically by spec §5.4's partition: SUPPORTED iff R ≥ 1.5, permutation p < 0.05, the class-addition outcome is ADDS, and R_city > 1.0; NOT SUPPORTED iff R ≤ 1.0, or R_city ≤ 1.0, or the class-addition outcome is SIZE-ONLY; INCONCLUSIVE in every remaining case.
claims.boundary: The partition is exhaustive over (R, p, class-addition, R_city). One clause diverges from Spec 047's partition, openly: permutation non-rejection with R > 1.0 is INCONCLUSIVE here, because D-10's text fixes NOT SUPPORTED as ratio at or below 1.0 or size alone explaining the pattern — the design governs (DD-051-3). No threshold is adjusted for the small site count.
alternatives: re-deriving thresholds from the observed shares, or importing Spec 047's non-rejection clause to harden an inconclusive outcome into a falsification (both refused: the frozen partition is the verdict)
falsification_tests: the verdict assignment is recomputed from the published quantities by any reader; a verdict not following this partition from its run's numbers falsifies the outcome record

claims.text: No outcome under Spec 051 establishes that the arrow sign meant border enforcement or guild authority, and no outcome falsifies the sign's recorded case-ending role.
claims.boundary: A distribution can fit the border story without proving the gloss — the design's own limit — and a positional role and a border-enforcement meaning could both be true, or neither. The single distributional exception is §5.4's SIZE-ONLY clause, which states that size fits the shares better than class; it is a preference between distributional accounts, not a disproof of either gloss, and the outcome wording says so.
alternatives: a meaning narrative attached to a SUPPORTED outcome because the distribution 'points to' checkpoints (refused: pointing is not translation, and the rival role survives every distributional outcome)
falsification_tests: inspection of every Spec 051 output: a meaning claim, or a claim that the case-ending role is disproved, in any output falsifies compliance and is corrected by dated addendum, never by silent edit
